Money.description: Money in minor units (cents). No floating point in money paths (R29).

description: A way to spend the reward balance: cash, or a partner reward from a registered supplier.

description.description: The partner's own words; the app shows cash in the customer's language.

family.description: A configured reward family (`rewards.families`); `cash` for the cash offer.

funded_by.description: Who funds the value above the price.

partner_id.description: The supplier that delivers it (`config/suppliers.yaml`); none for cash.

price.description:
Taken from the reward balance: what the insurer pays the supplier when it is delivered.
The supplier's spare capacity funds the value above it.

title: RewardOffer
